text:
Maya Patel: heads up — CloudEdge (AWS marketplace) says they didn't receive three March payouts we marked as paid. internal ledger shows settlement but bank says no wire. anyone seen this pattern?
Liam Chen: thanks, can you drop the payout csv + settlement IDs? i'll cross-check with bank export.
Maya Patel: s3://redwood-prod/finance/payouts/2026-03/cloudedge-march.csv — main ones are settlement_id 489201, 489202, 489315
FinanceBot: Automated reconciliation job ran 2026-03-18T09:12Z. 3 items flagged as "payment_sent" but no bank confirmation. CaseID: RB-9421.
Raj Kapoor: quick diff of marketplace vs ledger: ```sql
SELECT settlement_id, marketplace_amount, ledger_amount, payment_status
FROM payouts
WHERE partner = 'CloudEdge' AND month = '2026-03'
ORDER BY settlement_id;
-- returns 489200..489316, three rows payment_status='sent' but bank_ref IS NULL```
Ashley R.: ugh. possible causes: failed ACH, wrong beneficiary details, or marketplace delayed remittance. i'll open a payment-ops ticket and ping aws-mktplace support.
Sam Price: also check for reserve/chargeback flags — if any refunds hit after settlement we sometimes hold funds. Not common for marketplace but worth verifying.
Liam Chen: i pulled bank export for 03/25-03/31 — no matches for those settlement_ids. Bank reference numbers are missing. i can escalate to ops to run a trace.
Maya Patel: emailing partner now to confirm account details + ask for incoming wire search. cc: @Liam Chen, @Ashley R.
Ashley R.: filing payment-ops ticket now — TKT-5602. assigning to @payments-ops. note in ticket: include settlement ids, file from s3, ledger txns.
FinanceBot: Ticket TKT-5602 created and linked to Case RB-9421.
Raj Kapoor: another thing to check: our AWS Marketplace payout connector sometimes double-tags records when refunds are ingested after settlement. i ran a quick grep and saw three `refund_processed` events around 2026-03-20 for CloudEdge orders 2026-03-20T02:14Z.
Maya Patel: interesting — if refunds caused auto-withhold at marketplace side, maybe they reversed before sending final wire. i'll ask partner whether they saw reversal notices.
Liam Chen: next steps: 1) payments-ops to trace wires (TKT-5602) 2) ops to request AWS payout ledger for those settlements 3) Maya to confirm partner bank details 4) Sam to check for holdbacks/chargebacks in internal system. i'll update RB-9421 when bank responds.
Ashley R.: noted. if bank trace fails, we should be ready to issue a manual wire and debit the partner reconciliation reserve. @FinanceBot add recommended action: manual_wire_if_unresolved.
FinanceBot: Recommended action appended to RB-9421: "manual_wire_if_unresolved".
Maya Patel: partner replied: they confirm no incoming wire, their accounting says AWS shows 'scheduled' then 'skipped' for those settlements. forwarding screenshots.
Raj Kapoor: that aligns with connector bug — the connector marked records as `payment_sent` when marketplace moved status to scheduled. will open infra bug and add more strict check on bank_ref presence before marking sent.
Liam Chen: thanks — can you open infra bug and link to RB-9421? also add regression test for payout mapping.
Raj Kapoor: opened INFRA-3147 and linked RB-9421 + TKT-5602. brief title: "payout-connector: mark 'payment_sent' only after bank_ref persisted"
Maya Patel: OK — ops will wait 48h for AWS response. if no bank confirmation by 2026-03-20 we'll proceed with manual wire and adjust partner reserve per policy. i'll put that timeline in RB-9421.
Ashley R.: :thumbsup: will draft partner communication template in case we need to request reimbursements or adjustments.
Sam Price: logging this as pricing/settlement risk for Q1 — will flag in monthly finance notes.
Liam Chen: excellent. keep updates here and in RB-9421. thanks all.
Maya Patel: thanks everyone — closing loop later.
